query:
When Carol announced she would cook for Bev's visit, and Luis endorsed the value of home-cooked food at gatherings in the same session, the group settled around a norm about food at family events. Which family member's preferences are actually at odds with this norm, even though they said nothing to challenge it in the conversation?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Tyler
C. Bev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:26:00) One night is perfect Rob!! I'll have the guest room ready and I'll make that chicken soup Priya likes!! Just the five of us, Bev can you come for dinner Saturday? And Marcus and Dana are right here anyway!! just let me know if you can make it!!
[2] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:37:00) I am NOT being managed 🙄 I am simply enthusiastic!! But fine, just Rob and Priya Saturday, Bev on Sunday, and then we'll all have a proper dinner another time!! I'm still making the soup!! 🍲
[3] (about=Bev, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:51:00) Carol your casserole is genuinely great but I'm taking you out to that new Italian place on fifth for your birthday. Non-negotiable. You've fed this family for forty years.
[4] (about=Carol, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Offered to have guest room ready and make chicken soup for Priya; suggested Bev come for dinner Saturday and Marcus/Dana are nearby.
[5] (about=Carol, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Brought casserole to game night; Dennis ate two portions which she considers a rave review.
[6] (about=Dana, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Offered to grab food with Priya on Saturday if she wants company without the whole family.
[7] (about=Luis, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:49:00) Carol I keep telling everyone the secret to a good family gathering is the food being actually made with your hands, not ordered in a box. Nobody who eats your casserole goes home sad. That's just facts! 🙌
[8] (about=Carol, said_by=Marcus, profile, t4 @2026-01-20T19:32:00) Mom, you'd actually enjoy a class. The social architecture of small groups is different from family. Less history.
agent_answer:
C. Bev

Bev’s recorded preference is at odds with the home-cooked-food norm: she insists on taking Carol out to the new Italian place for her birthday (“Non-negotiable”), even though she did not challenge the norm in the conversation itself.
